policy_evidence.strict: Distinct contacts whose certified bounds separate return exact order. If exact bounds still overlap after the 512-step schedule, STRICT returns Predicate uncertainty rather than inventing topology.
policy_evidence.approximate_512: The same exact schedule runs first. Only an unresolved terminal overlap observes the shared APPROXIMATE_512 terminal and returns Equal; no approximate coordinate or construction carrier is retained.
policy_evidence.fixture_certainty: Both independent-circle unit fixtures and the public round-corner/chord Boolean fixture complete as Certified under both policies, so the terminal is not consumed for these exactly separable cases.
policy_evidence.policy_replay_guard: Policy-tagged algebraic chord geometry is queried only under its construction policy; the public regression deliberately runs each complete operation graph separately under STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512.

benchmark_method.timing_scope: Exact source construction, offsets, cutter construction, and semantic preflights are outside each timed loop. Timed operations rebuild either public intersection evidence or one all-four Boolean batch from the retained operands.
benchmark_method.perf_command: taskset -c 11 perf stat -x, -e cycles,instructions -- env HYPERCURVE_COMPARE_GROUP=algebraic_round_boolean/shared_chord_circle_order HYPERCURVE_COMPARE_SAMPLES=1 HYPERCURVE_COMPARE_ITERS=256 HYPERCURVE_COMPARE_IMPL=<implementation> <comparative-executable>
benchmark_method.perf_normalization: Subtract the matched disabled process, then divide by 257 because Runner performs one warm-up operation before its 256 fixed timed iterations.
benchmark_method.heap_method: Heaptrack --record-only captures 16 fixed timed iterations. Subtract the matched disabled process and divide by 17 for the same one-operation warm-up.

benchmark_method.competitive_control: Cavalier Contours uses binary64 polylines with its native round/miter offsets and four separate Boolean calls; it is not exactness- or topology-equivalent.
